propositions: Plans citing symbols/files that prerequisites will create are flagged missing/unverifiable and blocked, even though plan-review prose states depends_on-created symbols should be treated as existing
The citation rule is unwired: grounding finders only check origin/main snapshot and never consult a ticket's depends_on prerequisites

A two-layer citation system using [rebar:<id>] tokens must verify both upstream directions (P.depends_on(C) and C.blocks(P)) at the deterministic advisory layer and check coverage via LLM show_ticket review at the grounding layer, without adding floor-level blocks
Layer-1 reverse lookups via resolve_deps must fail-closed: exceptions during ticket resolution are caught and the citation treated as unverified, never propagating errors into the advisory lane
Layer-2 grounding finders credit a citation only when both the edge is Layer-1-verified AND the LLM affirmatively confirms the cited ticket's plan/file_impact provides the missing functionality
Uncited, edge-unbacked, or coverage-unconfirmed citations yield no credit and the original missing-symbol finding stands
